title.narrative: Technical Support For Enhancing National Capacity To Prevent And Reduce Child Labour In Vietnam

description.narrative: Support the prevention and reduction of child labor in Vietnam through the following intermediate objectives: Increased capacity of national institutions and stakeholders to identify and respond to child labor through improvements in relevant policies and legislation policy and legal formulation, enhanced implementation of policies and monitoring and enforcement of laws, as part of a broader effort to promote adherence to international labor standards; Increased awareness of child labor, hazards associated with child labor and prohibitions against child labor across all levels of society; Integrated area-based intervention models aimed at preventing and withdrawing children at risk or in the worst forms of child labor in selected rural and urban geographical areas and sectors.
